title: uGAN-fix
summary: A small research codebase implementing multiple tabular-data GAN generators (TableGAN, CTGAN) for experimentation and comparison. It directly imports and runs the standalone ctgan package's CTGANSynthesizer to fit and sample models, and pulls dataset loaders and legacy baseline synthesizer classes from SDGym for its TableGAN implementation.
needs: rdt import present but no call site shown; sdgym.synthesizers.base.LegacySingleTableBaseline is subclassed in tablegan_helper.py suggesting possible derivative_work, unverified from snippet
